## Textarea.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The text. Bindable; works controlled and uncontrolled.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new text whenever it changes.
- `size` :: The text scale. The height follows the content and `rows`. `textSize` overrides this. @default 'lg'
- `gap` :: Space between the field and the counter below it on the shared gap ladder.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted, and sets the scale of the counter.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the counter while there is room left; it turns to the danger tone at the limit.
- `shape` :: The corner shape. @default 'modern'
- `variant` :: `outline` is a bordered field, `secondary` a tinted one without a border, `ghost` is bare until hovered or focused. @default 'outline'
- `invalid` :: Marks the field invalid (red border, `aria-invalid`). Inside a `Field` it follows the field's error unless set.
- `autosize` :: Grows the field with its text using CSS `field-sizing: content`, between `rows` and `maxRows` lines.
- `rows` :: The number of visible lines — the fixed height, or the minimum when `autosize` is on.
- `maxRows` :: The most lines an autosizing field grows to before it scrolls.
- `maxlength` :: The most characters allowed.
- `counter` :: Shows a live character count under the field; with `maxlength` it reads `count / max`.
- `resize` :: Which directions the user can drag-resize the field. Autosizing fields do not resize.
- `ref` :: The underlying `<textarea>` element. Bindable.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the frame.

### `function fit`

Where `field-sizing` is missing, mirror the content height into --fit.
